name: Convex hull
description: Calculates the convex hull for each feature in an input layer.

name: Delaunay triangulation
description: Creates a polygon layer with the Delaunay triangulation corresponding to a points layer.

name: Delete holes
description: Creates a vector layer in which polygons with holes are replaced by polygons with only their external ring.

parameters.name: MIN_AREA
parameters.description: Remove holes with area less than

name: Densify by count
description: Creates a densified version of geometries by adding a fixed number of vertices to segments.

name: Densify by interval
description: Creates a densified version of geometries by setting a maximum distance for segments.

name: Dissolve
description: Combines features of a vector layer into new features, optionally grouped by common attributes.

name: Drop M/Z values
description: Removes any measure (M) or Z values from input geometries.

name: Explode lines
description: Creates a line layer in which each feature represents a segment from an input line layer.

name: Add geometry attributes
description: Computes geometric properties of the features in a vector layer.

name: Extend lines
description: Extends LineString geometries by extrapolating the start and end segments.

name: Extract M values
description: Extracts m values (or m value statistics) from geometries into feature attributes.

name: Extract specific vertices
description: Generates a point layer with points representing specific vertices in the input geometries.

name: Extract vertices
description: Generates a point layer with points representing the vertices of the input geometries.

name: Extract Z values
description: Extracts z values (or z value statistics) from geometries into feature attributes.

name: Filter vertices by M value
description: Filters away vertices based on their m-value value.

name: Filter vertices by Z value
description: Filters away vertices based on their z-value value.

name: Fix geometries
description: Attempts to create a valid representation of a given invalid geometry without losing any of the input vertices.

name: Force right-hand-rule
description: Forces polygon geometries to respect the Right-Hand-Rule.

name: Geometry by expression
description: Updates existing geometries (or creates new geometries) for input features by use of a QGIS expression.

name: Interpolate point on line
description: Interpolates a point along lines at a set distance.

name: Keep N biggest parts
description: Creates a polygon layer in which multipart geometries have been removed, leaving only the n largest (in terms of area) parts.

name: Line substring
description: Returns the substring of lines which fall between start and end distances.

name: Merge lines
description: Joins all connected parts of MultiLineString geometries into single LineString geometries.

name: Minimum enclosing circles
description: Calculates the minimum enclosing circle which covers each feature in an input layer.

name: Multipart to singleparts
description: Takes a vector layer with multipart geometries and generates a new one in which all geometries contain a single part.

name: Multi-ring buffer (constant distance)
description: Computes multi-ring ('donuts') buffer using a fixed or dynamic distance and number of rings.

name: Offset lines
description: Offsets lines by a specified distance.

name: Oriented minimum bounding box
description: Calculates the minimum area rotated rectangle which covers each feature in an input layer.

name: Orthogonalize
description: Takes a line or polygon layer and attempts to orthogonalize all the geometries in the layer.

name: Point on surface
description: Returns a point guaranteed to lie on the surface of a geometry.

parameters.name: ALL_PARTS
parameters.description: Create point on surface for each part

name: Points along geometry
description: Creates regularly spaced points along line features.

name: Pole of inaccessibility
description: Creates a point layer with features representing the most distant internal point from the boundary of the surface for a polygon layer.

name: Polygonize
description: Creates a polygon layer from the input lines layer.

parameters.name: KEEP_FIELDS
parameters.description: Keep table structure of line layer

name: Polygons to lines
description: Converts polygons to lines.

name: Project points (Cartesian)
description: Creates a point layer with geometries projected by a specified distance and bearing (azimuth).

name: Promote to multipart
description: Generates a vector layer in which all geometries are multipart.

name: Rectangles, ovals, diamonds
description: Creates rectangle, oval or diamond-shaped polygons from an input point layer.

name: Remove duplicate vertices
description: Removes duplicate vertices from features, wherever removing the vertices does not result in a degenerate geometry.

name: Remove null geometries
description: Removes any features which do not have a geometry from a vector layer.

name: Reverse line direction
description: Reverses the direction of curve or LineString geometries.

name: Rotate
description: Rotates feature geometries by a specified angle clockwise.

name: Roundness
description: Calculates the roundness of polygon features.

name: Segmentize by maximum angle
description: Segmentizes a geometry by converting curved sections to linear sections, given the maximum allowed radius angle between vertices on the straightened geometry.

name: Segmentize by maximum distance
description: Segmentizes a geometry by converting curved sections to linear sections, given the maximum allowed offset distance between the original curve and the segmentized representation.

name: Set M value from raster
description: Sets the M value for vertices to values sampled from a raster layer.

parameters.name: NODATA
parameters.description: Value for NoData or non-intersecting vertices

name: Set M value
description: Sets the M value for geometries in a layer.

name: Drape (set Z value from raster)
description: Sets the z value for vertices to values sampled from a raster layer.

parameters.name: NODATA
parameters.description: Value for NoData or non-intersecting vertices

name: Set Z value
description: Sets the Z value for geometries in a layer.

name: Simplify
description: Simplifies the geometries in a line or polygon layer by removing a number of vertices.

name: Single sided buffer
description: Buffers lines by a specified distance on one side of the line only.

name: Smooth
description: Smooths the geometries in a line or polygon layer by adding vertices and rounding corners.

name: Snap geometries to layer
description: Snaps the geometries to the geometries within the same layer or from another layer.

options.0: Prefer aligning nodes, insert extra vertices where required
options.1: Prefer closest point, insert extra vertices where required
options.2: Prefer aligning nodes, don't insert new vertices
options.3: Prefer closest point, don't insert new vertices
options.4: Move end points only, prefer aligning nodes
options.5: Move end points only, prefer closest point
options.6: Snap end points to end points only
options.7: Snap to anchor nodes (single layer only)

name: Snap points to grid
description: Modifies the coordinates of geometries in a vector layer, so that all points or vertices are snapped to the closest point of a grid.

name: Split lines by maximum length
description: Splits lines into parts which are not longer than a specified length.

name: Subdivide
description: Subdivides the geometry into parts that have less than a specified maximum number of nodes.

name: Swap X and Y coordinates
description: Swaps the X and Y coordinate values in input geometries.

name: Tapered buffers
description: Creates tapered buffers along line geometries.

name: Transect
description: Creates transects on vertices for (multi)linestrings.

parameters.name: ANGLE
parameters.description: Angle in degrees from the original line at the vertices

name: Translate
description: Moves the geometries within a layer, by offsetting them with a specified x, y, z or m displacement.

name: Voronoi polygons
description: Generates a polygon layer containing the Voronoi diagram corresponding to input points.

name: Create wedge buffers
description: Creates wedge shaped buffers from input points.

name: Clip
description: Clips a vector layer using the features of an additional polygon layer.

name: Difference
description: Extracts features from an input layer that fall outside, or partially overlap, features in an overlay layer.

name: Extract/clip by extent
description: Creates a vector layer that only contains features which intersect a specified extent.

name: Intersection
description: Extracts overlapping portions of features between two layers.

parameters.name: INPUT_FIELDS
parameters.description: Input fields to keep (leave empty to keep all fields)

parameters.name: OVERLAY_FIELDS
parameters.description: Overlay fields to keep (leave empty to keep all fields)

name: Line intersections
description: Creates point features at the intersection of lines from two different layers.

parameters.name: INPUT_FIELDS
parameters.description: Input fields to keep (leave empty to keep all fields)

parameters.name: INTERSECT_FIELDS
parameters.description: Intersect fields to keep (leave empty to keep all fields)

name: Difference (multiple)
description: Extracts features from a layer that fall completely outside or only partially overlap the features from other layer(s).

name: Intersection (multiple)
description: Extracts portions of input features that overlap features from all other layers.

name: Union (multiple)
description: Checks overlaps between features on the same layer or on more layers and creates separate features for overlapping and non-overlapping parts.

name: Split with lines
description: Splits the lines or polygons in one layer using the lines or polygon rings in another layer to define the breaking points.

name: Symmetrical difference
description: Extracts the portions of features from two layers that do not overlap.

name: Union
description: Checks overlaps between features on the same layer or on two different layers and creates separate features for overlapping and non-overlapping parts.

name: Extract by attribute
description: Creates a vector layer that only contains features matching an attribute value from an input layer.

name: Extract by expression
description: Creates a vector layer that only contains features matching a QGIS expression from an input layer.

name: Extract by location
description: Creates a vector layer that only contains features matching a spatial relationship with the features in an additional layer.

parameters.name: INTERSECT
parameters.description: By comparing to the features from

name: Extract within distance
description: Creates a new vector layer with features that are within a specified distance from features in another layer.

parameters.name: REFERENCE
parameters.description: By comparing to the features from

name: Filter by geometry type
description: Filters features by geometry type.

outputs.name: NO_GEOMETRY_COUNT
outputs.description: Total count of features without geometry

name: Random extract
description: Generates a vector layer that contains only a random subset of the features in an input layer.

name: Select by location
description: Creates a selection in a vector layer based on the spatial relationship with features in an additional layer.

parameters.name: INTERSECT
parameters.description: By comparing to the features from

name: Select within distance
description: Selects features that are within a specified distance from features in another layer.

parameters.name: REFERENCE
parameters.description: By comparing to the features from

name: Add autoincremental field
description: Adds a new integer field to a vector layer, with a sequential value for each feature, usable as a unique ID for features in the layer.

name: Add field to attributes table
description: Adds a new attribute to a vector layer.

name: Add unique value index field
description: Adds a numeric field and assigns the same index to features of the same attribute value.

name: Add X/Y fields to layer
description: Adds X and Y (or latitude/longitude) fields to a point layer.

name: Drop field(s)
description: Deletes fields from a vector layer.

name: Explode HStore Field
description: Creates a copy of the input layer and adds a new field for every unique key in the HStore field.

parameters.name: EXPECTED_FIELDS
parameters.description: Expected list of fields separated by a comma

name: Extract binary field
description: Extracts contents from a binary field, saving them to individual files.

name: Field calculator
description: Computes a new vector layer with the same features of the input layer, but either overwriting an existing attribute or adding an additional attribute.

name: Refactor fields
description: Allows editing the structure of the attributes table of a vector layer, permitting field renaming, creation and deletion.

name: Rename field
description: Renames an existing field from a vector layer.

name: Retain fields
description: Retains selected fields from a vector layer.

name: Download vector tiles
description: Downloads vector tiles of the input vector tile layer and saves them in the local vector tile file.

name: Write Vector Tiles (MBTiles)
description: Exports one or more vector layers to vector tiles.

name: Write Vector Tiles (XYZ)
description: Exports one or more vector layers to vector tiles.
